purpose: Matched scheduling benefit on already inspected real PVC early observations, not new physical validation
design: Use all five temperatures, both original observation windows and all three original assumed bands. Candidate times are ALL actual source times strictly after the last selected observation; no interpolation or response-based subset
contract: Both algorithms call the identical strong full-half-line continuous positive-measure LP oracle, strict-feasibility solve and residual checker. Endpoints then median scheduling; only cross-time interval/secant reuse differs. No cross-algorithm cache; serial single-thread AB/BA/AB timing; setup/scheduling included, disk serialization excluded. Retain all first-repeat witnesses. Three same-process repeats are not independent machine measurements
claim_ceiling: Conditional task-cost benefit only. Existing real measurements and assumed observation bands do not establish calibrated material guarantees. Earlier responses/results were already inspected, so this is exploratory and not independent validation. Temporal reuse is available to classical solvers too; no claim of unique capability or a universal speedup
